acceptance: Global CC11 Expression has independent bounded sample-offset automation, strict control conversion, unity default and unchanged legacy-unity audio; mute preserves synthesis, and invalid transactions reject without live mutation.

Adaptive versioned configuration preserves exact 16-byte legacy unity states, supports validated 20-byte expression states and all model identities, and retains coherent bounded lock-free publication under concurrent recall.

Mono and stereo negotiation, exact scalar output, bounded buffer handling, omitted inactive outputs, silence masks and lifecycle behavior pass direct and actual loaded-module checks without changing existing stereo behavior.

Independent integration and legacy comparisons plus relevant core/host checks and all three SDK/module validators pass on Linux, Windows and macOS with source-bound results, explicit skips and no unsupported runtime claims.

User, state-format, build and named-DAW verification documents describe the observed feature scope, compatibility and remaining limits; physical calibration and separate numerical tasks are not promoted.
definition.target: One documented 73-key Mark I Stage specimen at its specified loaded electrical output; identity and measurements pending.

scope: Synthetic host controls and output-layout engineering; no physical fidelity or named-DAW acceptance.

comparison_rules.legacy_unity_audio: bit-identical within same build environment and sample format
comparison_rules.dyadic_expression_cases: exact bit comparisons, permitting either audio zero sign
comparison_rules.nondyadic_expression_double: 16 * epsilon_binary64 * abs(monitored reference), with explicit finite/zero handling
comparison_rules.nondyadic_expression_float: at most one final binary32 ULP
comparison_rules.curve_partitioning: Equivalent delivered piecewise linear curves with exact representable boundary anchors; no claim for rounded anchor changes.
